body:
PR #549 remains draft after fresh Astra MAX final scan 3. The two earlier probe defects are corrected, but the audit identified a new introduced liveness defect: a default turn can wait indefinitely for optional filesystem metadata after native spawn has already failed without a PID. The [complete final report](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7064575243) remains CHANGES_REQUIRED.

Under delegated blocker authority, [D203](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7064575474) selects a private 1,000 ms monotonic diagnostic budget, then the existing unknown start-failure result with definite non-submission. GPT Sol xhigh is implementing the bounded correction; actual Fable xhigh independently reviews it and separate actual Opus xhigh performs focused behavior QA after the reported quota reset. New evidence, current-head/current-target CI and native verification, and the existing D035/D042 coordinator completion are required. All three general scans are consumed; no fourth general scan or renewed Astra approval is selected. No merge, issue closure or owner deployment is implied.
